# Etsy (4 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /product | `product_id` / `url` | 5 | Get an Etsy listing by id or URL |
| /shop/products | `id` / `url` | 5 | List products in an Etsy shop |
| /product/similar | `product_id` / `url` | 5 | Get listings similar to an Etsy product |
| /search/suggestions | `query` | 5 | Get Etsy search suggestions |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- `a`? — the spec marks nothing required, but these are the parameters the endpoint accepts;
  a bare call usually will not work. See Endpoint Details for which combination to send.
- *(none)* — takes no parameters at all.
- A method prefix (**POST**, **DELETE**, **PATCH**) marks a non-GET endpoint; unmarked rows are GET.
- Every endpoint also accepts the `Cache-Control` header (send `no-cache` to bypass the
  response cache — billed at the normal rate) and `Idempotency-Key` (a UUID that makes a
  retry safe; a replay returns the cached payload without double-billing).

## Endpoint Details

_What each endpoint returns and when to reach for it._

### /product — 5cr

Returns one Etsy listing: title, description, price, currency, images, shop name, in-stock flag, and quantity. Pass the numeric listing id or the full etsy.com/listing/{id} URL. Search is not available on this surface yet; start from a known listing id or from GET /v1/etsy/shop/products. Similar listings for the same product: GET /v1/etsy/product/similar.

**Parameters**

- `country` *(optional)*: Ship-to country as a two-letter code. Default US. Changes currency and copy language when the listing supports it.
- `currency` *(optional)*: ISO 4217 currency code for the displayed price. Default USD.
- `language` *(optional)*: Listing copy locale, for example en-US, en-GB, fr, de. Default en-US.
- `product_id` / `url` — at least one required.
  - `product_id`: Etsy listing id, the numeric id in a listing URL: etsy.com/listing/1215970085 is listing id 1215970085. Listing ids also come back on every row of GET /v1/etsy/shop/products and GET /v1/etsy/product/similar. (one of: product_id, url; at least one required)
  - `url`: Full Etsy listing URL, for example https://www.etsy.com/listing/1215970085/custom-air-freshener. The listing id is extracted from the path. (one of: product_id, url; at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/etsy/product?product_id=<product_id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /shop/products — 5cr

Returns one page of listings from an Etsy shop, 36 per page, each with listing id, title, price, original price where discounted, image, shop name, and listing URL. Pass the shop name (AceElegance) or the shop URL. Sort by most_recent (default), price_low, or price_high. The result total Etsy reports equals the page size, so it is not returned: paginate until a page comes back short. Feed a returned listing id into GET /v1/etsy/product for the full listing.

**Parameters**

- `page` *(optional)*: Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter. Native upstream cursor param. Send the universal `cursor` instead: the API maps it to this name for you.
- `limit` *(optional)*: Listings per page, 1 to 36. Default 36.
- `sort_by` *(optional)*: Result ordering: most_recent (default), price_low, or price_high.
- `currency` *(optional)*: ISO 4217 currency code for displayed prices. Default USD.
- `cursor` *(optional)*: Universal pagination cursor. Send `pagination.next_cursor` from the previous response back verbatim: the API maps it to this endpoint's native `page` (page style). You never construct, decode, or look up a cursor. Omit it for page 1.
- `id` / `url` — at least one required.
  - `id`: Etsy shop name, the path in etsy.com/shop/AceElegance. Shop names also come back on every product as product.seller. (one of: id, url; at least one required)
  - `url`: Full Etsy shop URL, for example https://www.etsy.com/shop/AceElegance or https://aceelegance.etsy.com. (one of: id, url; at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/etsy/shop/products?id=<id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /product/similar — 5cr

Returns listings Etsy considers similar to a given product, typically around 12 rows, each with listing id, title, price, sale price where discounted, image, shop name, and the shop's aggregate rating. Pass the listing id or the listing URL. This is a single page: there is no cursor.

**Parameters**

- `country` *(optional)*: Ship-to country as a two-letter code. Default US. Changes currency and copy language when the listing supports it.
- `currency` *(optional)*: ISO 4217 currency code for displayed prices. Default USD.
- `language` *(optional)*: Listing copy locale. Default en-US.
- `product_id` / `url` — at least one required.
  - `product_id`: Etsy listing id, the numeric id in a listing URL: etsy.com/listing/1215970085 is listing id 1215970085. Listing ids also come back on every row of GET /v1/etsy/shop/products and GET /v1/etsy/product/similar. (one of: product_id, url; at least one required)
  - `url`: Full Etsy listing URL, for example https://www.etsy.com/listing/1215970085/custom-air-freshener. The listing id is extracted from the path. (one of: product_id, url; at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/etsy/product/similar?product_id=<product_id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /search/suggestions — 5cr

Returns Etsy's search autocomplete suggestions for a partial query, the same terms the search box shows. Useful for keyword expansion. Full listing search is not available on this surface yet.

**Parameters**

- `query`: Partial search query to autocomplete, for example leather.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/etsy/search/suggestions?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
